newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CARE assigns PR1+ rating to BEL.
newsitem.headline: India's CARE assigns PR1+ rating to BEL.

text.p: India's Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) said on Wednesday that Bajaj Electricals Ltd (BEL) has been assigned a PR1+ rating for its Commercial Paper programme upto 100 million rupees, taking the total amount of CP rated to 150 million rupees.

In a statement, it said CARE had in January 1997 also assigned a PR1+ rating to BEL's Commercial Paper programme of 50 million rupees. The rating indicates superior capacity for repayment of short-term promissory obligations.
